system: mixed legal system of Islamic religious law, the French civil code of 1975, and customary law

constitution.amend: proposed by the president of the union or supported by at least one third of the Assembly of the Union membership; adoption requires approval by at least three-quarters majority of the total Assembly membership or approval in a referendum

courts.highest: Supreme Court or Cour Supreme (consists of 7 judges)
courts.judges: Supreme Court judges - selection and term of office NA
courts.lower: Court of Appeals (in Moroni); Tribunal de première instance; island village (community) courts; religious courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of the Comoros

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; accepts ICCt jurisdiction
